curatorial_frame.premise: A focused photography subcollection about the mechanics of freedom: who gets access, who is excluded, what is permissioned, what is open, what is surveilled, what can be carried across a border, what can be said without reprisal, and what it means to leave.
in_scope: self-custody and self-sovereignty as lived practice
selection_standards: clarity of the control, access, custody, or exit theme
distinct voice and point of view
long-horizon relevance as document and image
curatorial_frame.outcome_interpretation: The 16 selected outcomes form a provisional program selection list, not a completed collection or accession list.

rules.work_type: original 1/1 photographic works made by the submitting artist
rules.theme: access, exclusion, permission, surveillance, custody, autonomy, and exit

rights.artist_requirement: Artist must be able to release the work under CC0 and warrant that release.
rights.depicted_people: Written consent required when people are depicted; consent documentation must be available on request.
rights.sensitive_personal_data: Submissions exposing sensitive personal data, doxxing vectors, or vulnerable situations do not fit the program.

submission_package: title, year, and location, or withheld where appropriate
75-150 word caption describing the threshold, control, custody, or exit dynamic
technical note covering process, camera or workflow, and material manipulation
confirmation that written consent documentation exists and can be provided on request when people are depicted

selection.method: TDH holders vote on eligible submissions in the single program Wave
selection.fallback: If a selected work is unavailable or does not meet program terms at acquisition, allocation rolls to the next eligible work in rank order
selection.selected_count_meaning: Sixteen observed WINNER rows are retained as a provisional ranked selection list; this is not a guaranteed acquisition quantity.

acquisition.quantity_formula: Determined by the number of Meme Cards minted
acquisition.first_mint_expectation_in_program_note: Expected to be minted for the first time on-chain through this process on a 6529 Network Museum common contract unless final program mechanics specify otherwise

required_before_acquisition_or_accession: contract, network, token, metadata, and media identity
TITLE_BINDING between any legal instrument and the specific transfer
technical, condition, preservation, and display records
accession statement and individual object record
registrar_gate.current_collection_register_effect: No selected outcome in this program record is an accession register entry.
registrar_gate.unresolved_fields_policy: Unknown values remain null or explicitly unverified; no value is inferred from a WINNER label, wallet custody, a transfer, an airdrop, or an artist's conditional CC0 statement.

non_claims: The program note and Wave selection do not by themselves prove that any selected work was minted, purchased, transferred, received, legally titled, rights-cleared, technically verified, or accessioned.
The program's planned custody reference is not evidence that any selected work is held by that address.
The current mint topology remains undecided between a dedicated 6529Stream instance and a subcollection on main Stream.
